profile.name: Brendan Eggers
profile.headline: Co-Founder & Director of Software Engineering
profile.summary: Product engineer who takes ambiguous products from the user problem to the system that runs them in production. Nine years of full-stack product work, from NBA.com to solo-CTO ventures, owning everything from the apps down to the pipelines and infrastructure.

experience.note: Venture-incubator arrangement: I build and co-own the products below inside LV.

bullets.text: Built Sidekick OS, a private knowledge assistant for executives, from zero to a working product. It gives an executive AI chat over their connected sources, plus an encrypted vault and inbox digests, on an Nx monorepo with Effect and Zero local-first sync.
Designed its per-user encryption, a DEK/KEK AES-256-GCM scheme that decrypts client-side. Destroying one key erases one user's data, which is how the product handles GDPR deletion.
Shipped upcredit, a rent-reporting credit product now live across the company's student-housing portfolio and built to run with almost no upkeep.
Spend about half the role teaching the org to build with AI. Office hours and formal lessons grew into an AI Builders Committee; colleagues now run their own workflows and automations.

experience.note: Independent venture and its own entity, founded in 2023 and incubated at LV Collective since October 2024.

bullets.text: Sole continuous engineer on a Texas alcohol-sales analytics platform for bar operators and investors: web app, Expo native app, marketing site, and API in one Bun + Turborepo monorepo with 29 shared packages. Active with paying customers; revenue covers operating costs.
Built the data engine on Apache Airflow: chained DAGs that fuse TABC filings, Google data, customer reviews, and dual geocoding into one canonical record per venue.

Run LLM modules in production for classification and fuzzy address matching, each gated by cheap deterministic checks, with a second-pass reviewer that flags its own disagreements for a human to settle.
Stood up the backend on Kubernetes solo, then dropped a high-maintenance Elasticsearch layer for plain SQL: less to operate, better latency.
Built the agent harness that maintains the repo overnight: AST-level lint rules, guardrail hooks agents can't edit, and a merge policy that only ratchets stricter.
Built NBA.com's score strip from the first commit and remained its primary owner as it grew into a durable live surface through the season.
Client-side tech lead for login and entitlements across web and connected devices (TV Everywhere, international broadcasters, the league's CIAM identity), packaged as a reusable React auth library.
Tech-led the League Pass purchase page and the block-rendering system behind it, which let marketing edit subscription pages without an engineer. Localized in three languages.
Helped launch Local Access in-market streaming, and built the Nike sign-up flow for the 2024 All-Star booth.
Mentored engineers as a senior IC, and a platform rotation I asked for produced the self-service repo-provisioning tool the DTC org standardized on.

experience.organization: OpenSlate, returned post-COVID; acquired by DoubleVerify

bullets.text: Core engineer on the conversion of the company's e-commerce platform to React, shipping dozens of data-rich React/Redux apps. A performance investigation connected a blocked render path directly to subscription conversion.

skills.label: Platform
skills.value: React, Next.js, React Native (Expo), Node, Bun, Effect, REST APIs, Postgres, Supabase, Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD, Apache Airflow (ETL), AWS

skills.label: AI systems
skills.value: LLM integration in production (Claude and OpenAI APIs), RAG, embeddings and vector search, agent orchestration and tool calling, MCP, prompt engineering, evals, guardrails, LLM cost optimization

skills.label: Approach
skills.value: Strong preferences, happy to defend them: local-first architecture, domain-driven design (DDD), red/green testing (TDD), adversarial cross-model agent review
